fishing: WHEN: Mon Nov 2 light winds expected after prior ENE chop, sheltered Lemon Bay / passes best early. PASSES-BEACH: redfish, flounder, pompano near Stump Pass / Englewood Beach on live shrimp, gold spoons. LEMON BAY: redfish, snook, trout, sheepshead on docks, mangroves, oyster bars, flats. NEARSHORE: mangrove snapper / cobia when calm. Baits: live shrimp, pilchards (1-3"), soft plastics, weedless gold spoons, popping cork. Sources: FL Sportsman SW (Capt. Greg Stamper Oct 30-Nov 1 windy low water producing redfish/snappers/trout/black drum), local reports.
redtide: FWC Oct 30: K. brevis not observed in Southwest Florida past week. Bloom concentrations in NW FL Bay and Gulf counties. No SWFL fish kills or respiratory irritation near Englewood/Manasota.
bacteria: Charlotte and Sarasota Healthy Beaches all Good. Manasota Key / Englewood Beach / Palm Island / Boca Grande GOOD (~10 CFU/100mL recent samples). No advisories.
fpl: Charlotte ~2, Sarasota ~149 outages (minor/isolated); no major Englewood/Manasota impact.
